description: This file defines the interface MerchantStoreService, which specifies methods for managing MerchantStore entities such as retrieving and saving them. It extends a generic service interface and declares specific methods related to MerchantStore objects.

classes.name: MerchantStoreService
classes.description: Interface defining service methods for MerchantStore management, including retrieval by code and saving/updating stores.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Retrieves a MerchantStore by its string code. Throws ServiceException on failure.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a MerchantStore by its code, similar to getMerchantStore, may be an alias or alternative method.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Persists a new MerchantStore or updates an existing one. Throws ServiceException on failure.
